She waves her hands enthusiastically while holding a small white bag featuring a colorful handheld console graphic. In the background, another woman in a white top sits at a dining table. The room features dark wood shelves filled with various collectible figurines and a large, ornate crystal chandelier hanging from the ceiling. (2) The camera perspective shifts slightly as the woman leans forward over the marble table. She carefully places her chest onto the platform of a large, silver and black electronic body fat scale. Her hands are clenched into fists at her sides as she looks down toward the device's screen. The lighting remains bright and even across the indoor setting. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the digital LCD display of the scale. The screen shows black digital numbers that change quickly, starting at '19.8 kg' and settling on '13.8 kg'. The physical surface of the scale around the screen has several buttons with Japanese text labels. The marble texture of the table is visible at the edges of the frame.
